Rules
King
The king moves one square in any direction – sideways, up/down or diagonally.
Queen
The queen moves any distance along a straight line – sideways, up/down or diagonally (rook and bishop combined). She cannot jump.
Rook
The rook moves any distance sideways or up/down. It cannot jump.
Bishop
The bishop moves any distance diagonally, so it always stays on squares of one colour. It cannot jump.
The knight jumps in an L-shape: 2 squares one way and 1 square at a right angle. It is the only piece that can jump over others.
Pawn
The pawn moves one square forward (upwards). From its starting row its first move may be two squares.
